items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I remember a concert with Al DiMeola and Jan Hammer that I went to in San Francisco

ctx.x: Have you ever had any trouble with playing the fusion type thing and volume and all that?

Oh yeah. Yeah, I mean, well I used to play with Cobham and sometimes you’d come off a gig and your ears would be ringing. And the roadie would come over and say, “Congratulations, you’ve gone beyond the threshold of pain for the third concert in a row.” And I’d say no wonder. And now I play, yeah, not I just won’t play so loud. I mean there’s only so loud I’ll play because it hurts my ears. There are certain frequencies that hurt my ears. I guess high frequencies really just go right through them. I remember a…
What about Weather Report? Do you have any thoughts on them?
